Files used by the reproduction:

```sh filename=lib/value.sh
message='<poc>'
```

```sh filename=lib/print.sh
print_message() {
  printf '%s\n' "$message"
}
```

Run `sh run.sh` from the reproduction directory:

```sh filename=run.sh
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
. ./lib/value.sh
. ./lib/print.sh
print_message
```

Observed output:

```text
<poc>
```

The final line is explanatory prose, outside every source file.
